appDescription: An app that shows travel records left along the route the vehicle has driven.

function.name: OPEN_TRAVEL_CRUMBS
function.description: Opens the Travel Crumbs screen so the driver can see their travel records.

function.name: RECORD_CURRENT_PLACE
function.description: Records the vehicle's current location as a draft place in the active trip after location consent and navigation readiness have been confirmed. Place details are completed later while parked.
